tuto_2:
Put your gear on by accessing your inventory.
 Press the top button or the 0num key on the keyboard
tuto_sector:
1. ◈ Telemetry: Click a system to inspect celestial telemetry.
2. ▷ Trajectory: Click again to plot the hyper-jump vector.
3. ⚡ Navigation: FTL Warp jump requires 500 fuel units and a warp drive.
4. ❖ System: Switch to detailed system view using the controls below.
tuto_system:
1. ◈ Navigation: Click a celestial body to analyze its composition.
2. ▷ Propulsion: Click again to engage orbital approach vector.
3. ❖ Velocity: Hold Shift to activate high-output hyperdrive.
4. ⚓ Landing: Reach orbit to access surface landing sites and POIs.
tuto_subsystem:
◈ LANDING & SUBCOM COMMUNICATIONS
Leave the cockpit console to reach a docked or surface destination.
For remote inquiries or negotiations, initiate contact via Subcom.

tuto_1: Use the directional keys or click on a destination to move. You can change the keyboard paramters in the settings menu.
tuto_inv_transfer:
The interface displays two inventories side by side:
• \c[3]On the left\c[0]: Your party's bag with its carry load gauge in \c[14]MU\c[0].
• \c[3]On the right\c[0]: The inspected container (locker, crate, ally or loot).
Beware of exceeding your maximum carrying capacity to avoid overweight penalties!
tuto_inv_commands:
The bottom bar provides quick shortcuts:
• \c[3]Take / Deposit\c[0]: Directly focus either the right or left list.
• \c[3]Dump All\c[0]: Grab all items from the container in one click.
• \c[3]Filter [Category]\c[0]: Simultaneously filter both inventories.
tuto_inv_action:
Selecting an item opens a quick action modal:
• Transfer \c[3]1 unit\c[0] or \c[3]All units\c[0].
• If a transfer causes overload, a \c[2]⚠️ red warning\c[0] alerts you instantly.
• You can also discard items from your bag.
tuto_inv_compare:
When a weapon or piece of armor is selected:
• The upper panel compares its stats with your currently equipped gear.
• Stat bonuses appear in \c[11]+green\c[0] and losses in \c[2]-red\c[0].
• The impact on your carrying weight in \c[14]MU\c[0] is calculated in real time.
tuto_disable_desc: Contextual tutorials can be re-enabled at any time from the Options menu.
